Save the changes made in a data editor

Source: R/dataEdit.R
dataEditCommit.Rd

dataEditCommit() saves the changes made in a data editor created by dataEditServer(), for example when the user presses a Save button in your shiny application. dataEditChanges() returns a summary of the changes that have not been saved yet, which is useful to enable a Save button or to ask the user to confirm.

Usage

dataEditCommit(x)

dataEditChanges(x)

Arguments

x

the reactive expression returned by dataEditServer().

Value

dataEditCommit() invisibly returns a list with the number of rows updated, inserted and deleted and the number of columns added, removed or renamed (NULL if no data is loaded). dataEditChanges() returns the same counts plus the number of edited cells and the total number of changes, and must be called in a reactive context (it updates as the data is edited).

Details

For database tables (see db_table()) the staged changes are written to the database in a single transaction: edited rows are updated, removed rows are deleted and new rows are inserted. If any row has been changed or removed by someone else since it was loaded, the whole commit is rolled back, nothing is written and an error of class "editr_conflict" is raised; the changes stay in the editor so the user can try again. After a successful commit the rows are loaded from the database again, so new rows show the keys generated by the database and the editor starts afresh.

For data in your R session (data frames, matrices, files, ...) nothing is written; the current data simply becomes the new starting point, so the review panel, change highlights and generated code start again from the committed data. Write the data returned by dataEditServer() wherever it needs to go in the same observer.

Author

Dillon Hammill, dillon.hammill21@gmail.com

Examples

if (interactive() && requireNamespace("RSQLite", quietly = TRUE)) {
  library(shiny)

  con <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), ":memory:")
  DBI::dbExecute(con, "CREATE TABLE cars (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    model TEXT, mpg REAL)")
  DBI::dbAppendTable(con, "cars", data.frame(
    model = rownames(mtcars), mpg = mtcars$mpg))

  ui <- bslib::page_fluid(
    shinyjs::useShinyjs(),
    dataEditUI(
      "cars",
      toolbar_right = actionButton("save", "Save", class = "btn-primary")
    )
  )

  server <- function(input, output, session) {
    cars <- dataEditServer("cars", data = dplyr::tbl(con, "cars"))

    # only enable saving when there is something to save
    observe({
      ch <- dataEditChanges(cars)
      shinyjs::toggleState("save", !is.null(ch) && ch$total > 0)
    })

    observeEvent(input$save, {
      res <- tryCatch(dataEditCommit(cars), editr_conflict = function(e) e)
      if (inherits(res, "editr_conflict")) {
        showNotification(conditionMessage(res), type = "error")
      } else {
        showNotification(paste(res$updated, "updated,", res$inserted,
                               "added and", res$deleted, "removed"))
      }
    })
  }

  shinyApp(ui, server)
}
